# Layer 3 contract fixtures

Maintenance route: team-quality.

Stage-specific fixture directories hold small reproducible inputs for discovery, source-contract and admission checks. Keep accepted and rejected cases distinct and bind each new fixture to a behavioral consumer. Do not substitute fixtures for production data.

Owning entrypoint: `tests/fixtures/README.md`.

This local document explains the directory role. Its presence does not certify the contents or close a product capability.
